items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee mentions 'Big Chief Moore' but does not mention 'Judge' or any relationship with a person named Judge. The interviewer asks about a nickname 'The Judge', but the interviewee does not respond to confirm or deny a connection to a person named Judge.

ctx.x: Kansas also. Then Red played his thing and I understand right now, this taping right now, he's in Europe, in Paris. That's nice. That's great. He's doing fine. I talked to Mrs. Richards and had them over to the house and, anyway, following the frolics in Columbus I came back and low and behold, in between, back to the Stuyvesant and Central Plaza the Metropole Cafe on 48th and Broadway had changed its policy to jazz and I was one of the first bands that opened that place into jazz. The line-up was Jimmy…
Was he called the Judge then, did he have that nickname at that time, The Judge?
